title: Item:Adamantine Coffer
wikitext:
[[File:Adamantine Coffer.png|thumb|300px|right|]]
'''Adamantine Coffer''' is an in-quest item in [[the Vault of Night]] raid, absolutely required for the completion of the raid.

'''Description''': The surface of this metal coffer is perfectly smooth, without any latch or keyhole. There is no obvious way to open it.

'''Binding''': {{Bind|no|drops=leaving}}

'''In-quest use''':
* To gain the coffer, complete North section of the raid, then go West past the barriers and kill the golems guarding it.
* Don't pick it up unless you know what to do with it.
* Bring the coffer East, where is must be disposed.
